quotes.quote: This was probably the BEST lunch I have had in a long time. Fresh, delicious, and it exceeded all my expectations.

quotes.quote: The best family run Italian deli I’ve found in London. Amazing sandwiches, incredibly gracious service and very good prices. A gem.
quotes.name: Aaron Ferrucci

quotes.quote: The locals’ secret place for lunch. Family run. Daily pasta specials and sandwiches. Great value.
quotes.name: SM

quotes.quote: Great little deli. Simone was a great server and makes a great toasted sandwich. Highly recommend.
quotes.name: Edwin Grimshaw

quotes.quote: Amazing people, best fresh food in London. I eat every day on my break. Proper best Italian shop — very clean inside.
quotes.name: Giuseppe Donzelli

quotes.quote: Lovely Italian family own it. Great food and atmosphere. The pastas are amazing. Hospitality untouchable. Busy, busy, busy — ideal if you’re going to the BBC.
quotes.name: Anna Lupton

quotes.quote: This place is special, just like being in Italy. Great coffee, Nutella muffins, and the best chocolate croissants.
quotes.name: William Christie

quotes.quote: Spicy salami sandwich with emmental and rocket is amazing.
quotes.name: Nick Humfrey

quotes.quote: Wicked family owned delicatessen. Gets a bit busy around lunchtime, but a chicken, avocado, emmental and rocket ciabatta is worth the wait.
quotes.name: Ryan Wylie

quotes.quote: Amazing little family joint that serves what might be the best value in Central London. Friday is lasagna day.
quotes.name: Tobias Wacker

quotes.quote: Authentic Italian deli. The roast chicken is beyond words. This place is the real deal.

quotes.quote: Great Italian café and deli. Loved their coffee and cannoli. They also sell Chinotto — wonderful.
